tests.name: ordered_json_push_back_parent_pointer
tests.intent: Verify that pushing elements into an ordered_json array correctly maintains parent pointers under JSON_DIAGNOSTICS.

tests.name: ordered_json_emplace_back_parent_pointer
tests.intent: Verify that emplace_back on an ordered_json array properly maintains parent pointers.

tests.name: ordered_json_object_subscript_growth
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json object operator[] growth correctly updates parent pointers without quadratic overhead.

tests.name: ordered_json_at_method_access
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json at() method accesses elements and sets individual parent pointer correctly.

tests.name: ordered_json_update_method_overload
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json::update() merges objects using operator[] assignments efficiently.

tests.name: ordered_json_update_iterators
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json::update() with iterator range correctly updates members.

tests.name: ordered_json_erase_object_members
tests.intent: Verify that erasing members from an ordered_json object correctly repairs remaining parent pointers.

tests.name: ordered_json_merge_patch_behavior
tests.intent: Verify that merge_patch works correctly on ordered_json objects with efficient assignments.

tests.name: ordered_json_copy_constructor_parents
tests.intent: Verify that copy construction of ordered_json properly sets up parent pointers without redundant traversal.

tests.name: ordered_json_move_constructor_parents
tests.intent: Verify that move construction of ordered_json retains or repairs parent pointers correctly.

tests.name: standard_json_push_back_array
tests.intent: Verify standard basic_json array push_back behavior with diagnostics.

tests.name: standard_json_emplace_object
tests.intent: Verify standard basic_json object emplace behavior with diagnostics.

tests.name: ordered_json_emplace_object_key
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json emplace with key and value properly inserts and tracks capacity.

tests.name: ordered_json_index_access_rvalue_key
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json operator[] with rvalue key strings works correctly.

tests.name: ordered_json_at_rvalue_key
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json at() method with rvalue key strings works correctly.

tests.name: ordered_json_push_back_value_type
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json push_back with object value_type pair works properly.

tests.name: ordered_json_nested_array_growth
tests.intent: Verify large nested ordered_json array generation under linear growth checks.

tests.name: ordered_json_erase_iterator
tests.intent: Verify erasing by iterator on an ordered_json object preserves container integrity and parent pointers.

tests.name: ordered_json_at_index_bounds
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json array at() with index bounds checking operates correctly.

tests.name: ordered_json_swap_containers
tests.intent: Verify swapping two ordered_json instances correctly updates or preserves states.

tests.name: test_stable_elements_map
tests.intent: Exercise basic_json with a standard std::map object type, triggering has_stable_elements, object_capacity returning 0, and set_parents_after_object_erase without reallocation/re-parenting.

tests.name: test_ordered_map_capacity_object
tests.intent: Exercise nlohmann::basic_json using ordered_map explicitly via custom object type definition to trigger is_nlohmann_ordered_map and object_capacity() member capacity tracking.

tests.name: test_array_resize_container_capacity
tests.intent: Exercise container_capacity() and resize path on arrays with JSON_DIAGNOSTICS enabled, checking container_capacity checks during push_back and resize.

tests.name: test_object_emplace_keytype_rvalue
tests.intent: Exercise basic_json object emplace and operator[] with rvalue KeyType string arguments, invoking container_capacity and set_parent_after_insert.

tests.name: test_update_members_iteratively
tests.intent: Exercise update_members_iteratively via update with iterator range on ordered_json objects to ensure target->operator[] is called per key.
